data.narrative:
Blackstar is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Daniel Edrisian, former OpenAI Codex engineer whose prior venture (Alex, YC W24) was acqui-hired by OpenAI in September 2025. The company has raised $12M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 9 private firms (including Palantir, Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition) and 1 public comparable (Palantir Technologies, ticker PLTR), though the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage companies with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach.

Given the sparse comparable data, Stage-Progression triangulation is the applicable method. Using the $12M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $30M. This approach assumes Blackstar will execute at rates consistent with frontier-tech software companies and converts prior capital deployment into forward valuation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M (low) to $34M (high), with $30M as the median point. The primary uncertainty is the absence of narrowly comparable Seed-stage peers; a single-method triangulation provides less confidence than multi-method consensus would. The founder's track record and sector expertise support the upper end of this range, but actual valuation will depend on near-term product traction and fundraising dynamics in the current AI & Software market.
